design_direction.rationale: A roofing contractor sells trust and a track record before anything else, so the page should open on the figures — rating, years in business, roofs completed — with a calm, document-like column that a homeowner comparing three quotes can scan quickly, and a quote request as the single action. I've kept the proof-first opening and stats lead since that's correct for a trade, but swapped the stamped/ledger/gallery treatment for a quieter type treatment, a column architecture, and a ticker signatur
design_direction.signature_why: A thin running line of the hard numbers — 4.8 rating, since 1988, 40,000 roofs, Golden Hammer wins — gives a nervous homeowner the proof-of-competence a roofer needs without theatrics.

blocks.heading: Common Questions
blocks.text: How long has Bert Roofing been in business? Bert Roofing has been in business since 1988, with Bert family roofing experience in Dallas dating to the 1960s. What areas in Dallas do you serve? We serve Greater Dallas, with a large concentration of work in Lakewood, Casa Linda, White Rock, Lake Highlands, Lower Greenville, and surrounding East Dallas neighborhoods. We also serve Preston Hollow, Highland Park, University Park, Richardson, Garland, and nearby areas. What types of roofing materials do you install? We install asphalt shingles, Class 3 and Class 4 impact-resistant shingles, standing seam metal, stone-coated steel, TPO, modified bitumen, and synthetic roofing products. Bert Roofing is a GAF Certified Contractor, Owens Corning Preferred Contractor, and CertainTeed Master Shingle Applicator. Do you offer free roof inspections? Yes. testimonials.author: Cristin Damon
testimonials.text: I can’t recommend Bert roofing enough. They provided a fast turn around on a roofing inspection and we were so impressed with the level of detail, we hired them to replace the roof once we closed. They were very timely, highly communicative, and great customer service. We are so happy with the outcome and the beautiful roof!

testimonials.author: Clint Compton
testimonials.text: Very thorough and very good. I have used Bert Roofing three times now. Each time they did and impeccable job and their pricing is very reasonable. Over the years, I have used other roofing companies, and they either charge a lot more or do a poor quality job and even worse they leave a huge mess everywhere. Bert Roofing is great because not only do they do a good job, and have a reasonable price, they clean up everything when they are done. I hope I don't need a lot of roofing in the future, but I will, of course, contact Bert if I need to.

testimonials.author: Ken Holt
testimonials.text: Bert and his crew did an excellent job repairing my roof leak and chimney leak. The crew was courteous and respectful. It took a couple weeks after the completion of the roof repair before we got a good rain fall to see how the roof held up. I am satisfied with the work and would highly recommend Bert and for roof repairs. You’re in good hands

testimonials.author: Jeff Vance
testimonials.text:
Bert Roofing did an excellent job on our roof.  It had suffered hail and wind damage.
Bill Chittum of Bert Roofing did a great job walking us through the insurance claim process as well as guiding us through selecting the type of new roof.
He was professional, knowledgeable and accessible.
We strongly recommend this company for your new roof needs.

testimonials.author: Jason Early
testimonials.text:
I had a significant roof leak that needed urgent attention. Bert Roofing came out within a few days of scheduling to fix the issue, and the owner gave me a reasonable, honest quote. The team was out to fix the issue within a few days afterwards and came back to inspect the roof again after the next hard rain.

Overall quick and efficient communication and solutioning from beginning to end. If I should have any future issues (hopefully not), I will be contracting this company again.
